descricao: SW signature uses CEPESC (proprietary algorithm). No script verifies it. Half of the chain of trust cannot be verified externally.
No script opens BU and RDV at the same time. The cross-check total(BU) vs sum(RDV votes) is never performed.
valida_assinaturas() verifies ONLY the HW signature. The SW signature is hash-checked but never cryptographically verified.
verifica_qrcode.py references certificates that do not exist in the ZIP. It ALWAYS fails. The error is silently swallowed.
v1/2022: tautological verification — the key embedded in the BU verifies the BU itself. Silently removed in v2.0.
SW signature uses tagChaves (opaque YYYYMMDDHHMM string) instead of an X.509 certificate. No chain of trust.
valida_certificado() only checks the signature against hardcoded CAs. It does not check validity dates, key usage, CRL or RFC 5280.
TipoVoto enums have DIFFERENT values in BU and RDV. nominal=1 in the BU, nominal=2 in the RDV. Cross-checking is impossible without a manual mapping.
bu_assinatura_tuplas.py extracts the key from the VSC without calling valida_certificado(). A self-signed cert passes.
